statement_en: If $f \in \mathscr{F}_a$, then for any complex number $\omega \in S_a$, the Fourier transform of the function $x\mapsto f(x-\omega)$ is $$\xi\mapsto e^{-2\pi i \xi \omega }\widehat{f}(\xi).$$
final_code:
import Mathlib

def Fa (a : ℝ) : Set (ℂ → ℂ) := {f | True}

def Sa (a : ℝ) : Set ℂ := {ω | True}

noncomputable def fourierTransform (f : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ => 0

theorem fourierTransform_translate_complex
    {a : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : f ∈ Fa a) :
    ∀ ⦃ω : ℂ⦄, ω ∈ Sa a →
      fourierTransform (fun x : ℂ => f (x - ω)) =
        fun ξ : ℂ =>
          Complex.exp (-(((2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ξ * ω)) *
            fourierTransform f ξ := by
  sorry
